finding: The project-external preflight wrapper could publish a technical failure after a formal preflight had already atomically published its PASS or PAUSE output; the launcher also trusted an authorization stdout substring instead of the terminal authorization JSON.

remediation.terminal_rule: An atomically published preflight output is the unique terminal irrespective of a later process return code; failure is published only when no output exists.
remediation.authorization_rule: Both component authorizations are staged and then validated from final JSON for exact component, status, and authorized Git HEAD.

invalid_interpreter_attempt.cause: Python 3.9 does not support zip(..., strict=True); the formal project and A100 runtimes require Python 3.10 or later.
